name: chart-radar-01
title: chart-radar-01
description: Customer survey · scores out of 100. Average across six dimensions from the June survey.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Product health” with the muted eyebrow “Customer survey · scores out of 100”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Show a six-axis radar for Reliability, Speed, Usability, Support, Value, and Features, with June scores 92, 78, 88, 84, 80, 90. Use a polar grid, small category labels, a hidden numeric scale from 0 to 100, and a 70% outer radius. Draw one 2px outlined polygon with 25% fill. Show 85.3 / 100 and explain the six-dimension June survey average in the footer.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
